title: Not That Way
goal: Black to play. Your two stones have one liberty. Running to it does not help.
hint: Count the white stones as well as your own. One of those chains is in more trouble than you are.
explanation: Playing the one empty point next to your stones runs into a wall and dies there. Taking the white chain instead opens the two points it was standing on -- when you are short of liberties, capturing is the fastest way to make some.
